# Update a fraud dispute case

Update a fraud dispute case **with the API** while it's a draft.
For example, add fraud details your user gives you later, add the victim, or change the transactions.
Once a case is submitted, it can't be changed.

:::tip Prerequisites
- The case is a `Draft`.
- You have a [project access token](/developers/using-api/authentication/guide-get-token-project), or a [user access token](/developers/using-api/authentication/guide-get-token-user) for a user who [can report the transactions](./index.mdx#fraud-permissions).
:::

## Guide {#guide}

1. Call the `updateDraftFraudDisputeCase` mutation.
1. Add the `disputeCaseId` (line 4).
1. Add the inputs you want to change (lines 5-6).
   Each input you send replaces the stored one, so send a complete `fraudDetails` even to change one field.
   Inputs you leave out don't change. Send `null` to clear one, except `transactionIds`, which returns `BAD_USER_INPUT`.
1. Add the success payload (line 9).
1. Add [rejections](./index.mdx#rejections) (not shown).

This example removes the card payments from a case and names the victim of the remaining transfer.

## Mutation {#mutation}

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?&tab=api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {4-6} showLineNumbers
mutation UpdateFraudDisputeCase {
  updateDraftFraudDisputeCase(
    input: {
      disputeCaseId: "$DISPUTE_CASE_ID"
      transactionIds: ["$TRANSFER_TRANSACTION_ID"]
      victimAccountMembershipId: "$VICTIM_ACCOUNT_MEMBERSHIP_ID"
    }
  ) {
    ... on UpdateDraftFraudDisputeCaseSuccessPayload {
      __typename
      disputeCase {
        id
        ... on FraudDisputeCase {
          hasVictim
          fraudCardDetails {
            isLostOrStolen
          }
        }
        updatedAt
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Payload {#payload}

When you change `transactionIds`, Swan removes details that no longer apply.
Here, `fraudCardDetails` is now `null` (line 8) because the case no longer includes card payments.

Each update also resets the draft's 30-day expiry.

```json title="Payload" {8} showLineNumbers
{
  "data": {
    "updateDraftFraudDisputeCase": {
      "__typename": "UpdateDraftFraudDisputeCaseSuccessPayload",
      "disputeCase": {
        "id": "$DISPUTE_CASE_ID",
        "hasVictim": true,
        "fraudCardDetails": null,
        "updatedAt": "2026-12-03T09:30:00.000Z"
      }
    }
  }
}
```
